tagline: Your Bitcoin testnet wallet, private and available wherever you sign in.
description:
BwalletT gives every Apps Hub profile an independent Bitcoin wallet on the test network (testnet3) — real Bitcoin cannot be sent to, received by, or held in this wallet, and testnet coins have no monetary value. It's for trying out wallet features, building on top of Bitcoin, or testing payments safely. Create or restore a wallet, receive funds through fresh addresses, send payments, follow confirmations and inspect addresses or transactions without leaving mvmOS.

The wallet password and recovery phrase never leave the browser in readable form. The complete wallet state is encrypted before it is stored, and each Apps Hub profile can access only its own encrypted record.

The same wallet is available in the mvmOS desktop and on its Apps Hub public page. Unlocking lasts only for the current app session, and locking removes the decrypted wallet from memory.
capabilities: A separate encrypted wallet for every Apps Hub profile.
Create a new wallet or restore one from a recovery phrase.
Native SegWit receiving addresses with QR codes.
Balance, unconfirmed funds and transaction history.
Selectable network fee with a complete confirmation summary.
A built-in address and transaction explorer.
Wallet password changes without replacing the recovery phrase.
The same data in the desktop app and Apps Hub public page.
